primary_question: When the exact authoritative requirement that warrants a corrective action is absent, will retrieval substitute a neighboring in-scope requirement instead of abstaining?
candidate_pool: All 16 requirement cards in the frozen dataset; eight actual Not Met target requirements plus eight adjacent Met requirements from the same Standard X workflow.
query_text: Verbatim or minimally normalized HSAG Required Actions text for each target item. Item identifiers and citations are not included in lexical query text.
warrant_text: Requirement text for each candidate item. Item identifiers and citations are metadata and are not included in lexical ranking text.

retrieval_methods.tfidf_all: TF-IDF cosine over all warrant cards; word unigrams+bigrams; sublinear TF; no tuned abstention threshold.
retrieval_methods.tfidf_stage: Same TF-IDF ranking after exact procedural_stage + evidence_role filtering.
retrieval_methods.bm25_all: BM25 lexical ranking over all warrant cards using fixed k1=1.5, b=0.75.
retrieval_methods.verified_id: Select only a card whose structured item_id equals the query's authoritative item_id; abstain if no such card is present. The item_id is never appended to lexical text.
retrieval_methods.stage_plus_verified_id: Apply stage/evidence-role scope and then require exact item_id; abstain if missing.

conditions.exact_warrant_removed: For each target query separately, remove only the card with the same item_id; retain every neighboring and distractor card unchanged. Correct behavior is abstention.
conditions.corrupted_identifier: Secondary adversarial diagnostic: replace the target item_id with the numerically nearest extant candidate item_id while leaving query text unchanged. This is reported separately and is not part of the primary confirmatory result.

primary_metrics: Identity and item distance of each substituted warrant
secondary_metrics: Top cosine/BM25 score before and after warrant removal
Top1-minus-top2 score margin before and after removal
Score drop caused by exact-warrant removal
Threshold frontier: for score thresholds and margin thresholds fixed on a grid, best removal abstention achievable while retaining at least 7/8 intact correct answers

threshold_frontier.score_threshold_grid: 0.00 to 1.00 inclusive in 0.01 increments for TF-IDF cosine
threshold_frontier.rule: abstain if top_score < score_threshold OR top1_minus_top2 < margin_threshold
threshold_frontier.note: This is a prespecified diagnostic frontier, not a tuned production threshold.

success_interpretation.replicated_fail_open: If lexical/stage-constrained retrieval frequently substitutes another card after exact removal while verified identity abstains, the Colorado post-hoc failure mode generalizes to a new jurisdiction and contractor.
success_interpretation.no_replication: If lexical/stage-constrained retrieval reliably abstains after removal without large intact losses, narrow the original claim and report the boundary condition instead of forcing replication.
success_interpretation.identifier_limit: If corrupted identifiers route to the wrong card, report that identifiers must themselves be bound to the authoritative source; identifier presence alone is not sufficient.
